title: U.S. House · Nevada's 3rd District
area: Southern and western Las Vegas Valley suburbs in Clark County, including Henderson and Summerlin.

context.text: Incumbent Susie Lee (D) won the Democratic primary and faces Republican nominee Marty O'Donnell in the general election. The district last elected a Republican in 2014; Lee won re-election 52.0%-48.0% in 2022 and 51.4%-48.6% in 2024, while Donald Trump defeated Kamala Harris 49.5%-48.8% in the district in 2024. As of July 2026, major election forecasters rated the race Lean Democratic.

summary.text: Susie Lee is the Democratic incumbent seeking re-election to U.S. House Nevada District 3. Before Congress she worked in policy consulting, served as a campaign policy advisor to Las Vegas Mayor Jan Laverty Jones, and founded a homeless shelter for parents and children.

background.text: Born in Canton, Ohio, in 1966; earned a bachelor's degree in policy and management and a master's degree in public policy and management, both from Carnegie Mellon University.
Moved to Las Vegas in 1993; worked as a campaign policy advisor to Las Vegas Mayor Jan Laverty Jones and founded a homeless shelter for parents and children in need.
Became president of the board of Communities In Schools of Nevada, a program aimed at lowering high-school dropout rates, in 2010.
Currently sits on the House Committee on Appropriations (Energy and Water Development, and Defense subcommittees) and the Committee on Natural Resources (2025-2026).

summary.text: Marty O'Donnell is the Republican nominee for U.S. House Nevada District 3, running in a district Ballotpedia has identified as a battleground race in a longtime Republican target.
Jon Kamerath is the Independent American Party candidate for U.S. House Nevada District 3.
